title: Taking after dropping from a truncated list
statement: Let $l$ be a finite bit string and let $N,a,b$ be natural numbers with $a+b\le N$. Taking $b$ entries after dropping the first $a$ entries from the first $N$ entries of $l$ gives the same list as taking $b$ entries after dropping the first $a$ entries of $l$.
